events.verdict: Middleton (WAS) brings his hands toward Brown's (DEN) back as they come together during the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Middleton (WAS) initiates body to body contact with Murray (DEN) that affects his SQBR during the drive.
Watson (DEN) releases the throw-in before 5 seconds elapses.
Murray (DEN) goes to, not through, George's (WAS) space and marginal contact occurs as Murray releases away during the drive.
George (WAS) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Brown (DEN) reaches for the ball and marginal contact occurs with George's (WAS) right arm that does not affect his SQBR.
Watson (DEN) maintains verticality as he defends George's (WAS) shot attempt.
George (WAS) brings his hand toward Murray's (DEN) path and marginal contact occurs during Murray's dribble.
George (WAS) reaches for the ball and makes marginal contact to Hardaway Jr.'s (DEN) body contact, which does not affect his SQBR.
George (WAS) commits a take foul on Hardaway Jr. (DEN).
Carrington (WAS) releases the throw-in before 5 seconds elapses.
Murray (DEN) legally contests George's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
